question_text: Find the angle between the following line segments and the base plane of the triangular prism:

mark_breakdown.desc: Correct minimum value identified from the boxplot

subparts.solution:
From the boxplot, the left whisker terminates at $4$.
$\text{minimum value} = 4\text{ cm}$

ai_explanation.concept_rule: The minimum value on a boxplot corresponds to the leftmost point of the lower whisker.
step_by_step: Locate the left end of the whisker on the horizontal axis.
Read off the value at this point, which is $4\text{ cm}$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Confusing the minimum with the lower quartile (the left edge of the box).

mark_breakdown.desc: Correct maximum value identified from the boxplot

subparts.solution:
From the boxplot, the right whisker terminates at $22$.
$\text{maximum value} = 22\text{ cm}$

ai_explanation.concept_rule: The maximum value on a boxplot corresponds to the rightmost point of the upper whisker.
step_by_step: Locate the right end of the whisker on the horizontal axis.
Read off the value at this point, which is $22\text{ cm}$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Confusing the maximum with the upper quartile (the right edge of the box).

mark_breakdown.desc: Correct median value identified from the boxplot

subparts.solution:
From the boxplot, the vertical line inside the box is at $17$.
$\text{median} = 17\text{ cm}$

ai_explanation.concept_rule: The median in a boxplot is indicated by the vertical line dividing the box into two parts.
step_by_step: Identify the line inside the central box.
Read off the corresponding value on the scale, which is $17\text{ cm}$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Mistaking the midpoint of the box for the median line.

mark_breakdown.desc: Correct upper quartile identified from the boxplot

subparts.solution:
From the boxplot, the right edge of the box is at $19$.
$\text{upper quartile} = 19\text{ cm}$

ai_explanation.concept_rule: The upper quartile ($Q_3$) is represented by the right boundary of the box.
step_by_step: Locate the right-hand boundary of the rectangular box.
Read the value on the axis, which is $19\text{ cm}$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Reading the maximum value at the end of the whisker instead of the box boundary.
